scope: Release-safe coverage matrix for named paper claims, figures, tables, equations, and appendices.

coverage_items.claim_summary: Deferred cross-parser reuse is the security pattern: retained host-like telemetry can later enter shell, query, template, URL, alert, or policy consumers.
coverage_items.privacy_boundary: Row-level live case chains and exploitable sink details are masked or external.

coverage_items.claim_summary: HIB is a 200,339,886-row, 835-tenant de-identified production replay with resolved, positive, and unresolved labels.
coverage_items.privacy_boundary: The checked-in bundle is a 150-row public sample; row-level paper-scale replay requires the external full HIB-Real bundle.

coverage_items.claim_summary: CCD scores behavior-preserving rewrite classes with a cone likelihood-ratio sketch, fixed-FPR calibration, and finite-edit stability checks.
verification_commands: python -m pytest tests/test_scoring.py tests/test_cone.py tests/test_calibration.py tests/test_certify.py
coverage_items.privacy_boundary: Executable detector mechanics run on public examples and release-safe aggregate priors, not raw tenant logs.

coverage_items.claim_summary: Replay, calibration, latency, family holdout, drift, hostile mimicry, and live overlap test the fixed detector under predeclared alert budgets.
coverage_items.privacy_boundary: Release-safe aggregates are public; full row-level replay, stress outputs, and live labels are external.

coverage_items.claim_summary: Source reachability, public-real scope, downstream evidence, and de-identified artifacts define coverage and reproducibility boundaries.
coverage_items.privacy_boundary: Public anchors and aggregate scope checks are released; raw private telemetry remains outside the artifact.

coverage_items.claim_summary: The deployed score is a log-sum-exp likelihood-ratio statistic over benign and positive cone-prior cross-entropies.
coverage_items.privacy_boundary: The score path is executable without private rows.

coverage_items.claim_summary: A deployed decision is stable over a declared edit ball when the score margin exceeds the bounded edit-induced score movement.
coverage_items.privacy_boundary: Certificates cover only the frozen normalizer, score path, threshold, and edit manifest.

coverage_items.claim_summary: The cone-count statistic's log-likelihood ratio reduces to the cross-entropy score used by CCD.
coverage_items.privacy_boundary: The derivation is represented by the public score implementation and method-contract check.

coverage_items.claim_summary: A retained host string can be rejected by routing but later parsed by a downstream SQL/query consumer.
coverage_items.privacy_boundary: The exact private motivating trace is not released; Table 8 aggregate case evidence is public.

coverage_items.claim_summary: The system architecture trains references, canonicalizes and embeds host strings, scores cone sketches, thresholds, and emits explanations/certificates.
coverage_items.privacy_boundary: The smoke path uses public examples and the checked-in sample bundle.

coverage_items.claim_summary: CAHO uses class-aware two-view augmentation: benign mild perturbations and positive attacker-style rewrites.
coverage_items.privacy_boundary: Full deployed-training provenance is external; the public code exercises the training path and checkpoint format.

coverage_items.claim_summary: CCD compares a query cone sketch against benign and executable-reference distributions and flags above threshold.
coverage_items.privacy_boundary: The scoring kernel is public; paper-scale priors require the full release or aggregate attestations.

coverage_items.claim_summary: CCD leads baseline recall at FPR=1e-4 while meeting the production latency budget.
coverage_items.privacy_boundary: Public aggregate timing is released; raw production serving traces are external.

coverage_items.claim_summary: Leave-one-family-out performance tests held-out attack-family generalization.
coverage_items.privacy_boundary: Aggregate family-holdout ranges are released; row-level stress outputs are external.

coverage_items.claim_summary: Finite-edit stability coverage is reported for detected positives and compared against baselines.
coverage_items.privacy_boundary: Exact verifier mechanics are public; paper-scale coverage counts are release-safe aggregates.

coverage_items.claim_summary: Decision and stability contracts cover cone-count likelihood, split calibration, and edit closure assumptions.
coverage_items.privacy_boundary: Contract assumptions are public and release-safe.

coverage_items.claim_summary: Evidence and accounting units define replay, positive, live, alert, tenant-visible, and unresolved denominators.
coverage_items.privacy_boundary: Denominator rules are aggregate and release-safe.

coverage_items.claim_summary: HIB production-replay source/resolved/unresolved profile reports 200,339,886 rows.
coverage_items.privacy_boundary: Aggregate profile is public; row-level reproduction requires the external full HIB-Real bundle.

coverage_items.claim_summary: Verified-positive production replay profile reports family, sink, and obfuscation denominators.
coverage_items.privacy_boundary: Aggregate denominators are public; row-level verified-positive evidence is external or masked.

coverage_items.claim_summary: Fixed-FPR baseline audit reports TPR/FPR and p99/p99.9 latency across CCD and baselines.
coverage_items.privacy_boundary: Aggregate baseline metrics are public; raw replay predictions and serving traces are external.

coverage_items.claim_summary: Mechanism ablation reports recall-point drops from full CCD under matched fixed-FPR splits.
coverage_items.privacy_boundary: Aggregate ablation cells are public; full run outputs are external.

coverage_items.claim_summary: Matched live overlap reports CCD vs Regex/WAF verified positives, uncertain items, benign review load, composites, and tenant-facing alerts.
coverage_items.privacy_boundary: Aggregate overlap cells are public; row-level live labels and response-owner records are external.

coverage_items.claim_summary: Controlled sink-evidence traces report shell diagnostic, analytics/query, and alert-action replay cases.
coverage_items.privacy_boundary: Aggregate controlled evidence is public; exploitable sink details, callback domains, credentials, and tenant names are withheld.

coverage_items.claim_summary: Attack-family distribution reports counts and shares for 363,401 verified production-replay positives.
coverage_items.privacy_boundary: Aggregate family distribution is public; row-level positive strings require the full release.

coverage_items.claim_summary: LLM baseline identifiers list the locally served checkpoints used in matched production replay.
coverage_items.privacy_boundary: Checkpoint identifiers are public; local serving traces and full predictions are external.

coverage_items.claim_summary: Reproducibility boundary separates released/recomputable claims from private-by-design data.
coverage_items.privacy_boundary: The checker verifies that Table 11 external boundaries appear as manifest completion items.

coverage_items.claim_summary: White-box hostile-mimicry recall reports CCD and strongest baseline recalls under marker-preserving, marker-erasing, cone-escape, DNS-label, and IDNA suites.
coverage_items.privacy_boundary: Aggregate mimicry cells are public; full stress cases and predictions are external.

coverage_items.claim_summary: Case studies and sink evidence describe deployment-observed shell, alert-action, and analytics reuse patterns plus attack-family composition.
coverage_items.privacy_boundary: Case-study traces are controlled and masked; raw private traces are external.

coverage_items.claim_summary: Dataset profile, splits, released benchmark contents, labels, repairs, and full HIB-Real completeness are specified.
coverage_items.privacy_boundary: The source repo carries a checked-in sample; full row-level completeness depends on the external release bundle.

coverage_items.claim_summary: Frozen configuration, edit model, likelihood-ratio derivation, CAHO training recipe, LLM baseline IDs, and synthetic-validity checks are specified.
coverage_items.privacy_boundary: Public code validates frozen contracts and aggregate synthetic-validity cells; full training provenance and run outputs are external.

coverage_items.claim_summary: Ethics, de-identification, risk handling, disclosure, and label scope are documented.
coverage_items.privacy_boundary: Ethics documentation intentionally withholds tenant identities, unresolved strings, and exploitable private sink details.

coverage_items.claim_summary: Reproducibility path rebuilds denominators, thresholds, resolved metrics, detector outputs, and overlap views from released data where privacy permits.
coverage_items.privacy_boundary: Strict-final readiness remains open until DOI URLs and external full replay/stress artifacts are staged.

coverage_items.claim_summary: Synthetic-real validity, adjacent-field scope, and hostile mimicry define additional scope and stress checks.
